title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Acts 3: the lame man healed at the Beautiful gate and Peter's words to the people in Solomon's porch.

questions.text: At what hour were Peter and John going up into the temple?
questions.explanation: They were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

questions.text: How long had the man at the temple door been lame?
questions.explanation: He was a man lame from his mother's womb, who was carried and laid daily at the temple door.

questions.text: What was the temple door where he was laid called?
questions.explanation: He was laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy.

questions.text: What did Peter say he had none of?
questions.explanation: Peter said he had no silver or gold, but gave what he had in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

questions.text: What happened immediately when Peter took him by the right hand?
questions.explanation: Peter raised him up, and immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

answers.text: His feet and ankle bones received strength
He fell down at the door in fear
He asked them for money again
He was carried into the temple

questions.text: What was the man doing as he entered the temple with them?
questions.explanation: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk, and he entered the temple walking, leaping, and praising God.

answers.text: Asking for gifts at the gate

questions.text: In which porch did all the people run together to Peter and John?
questions.explanation: As the healed man held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch called Solomon's.

questions.text: Whose God did Peter say had glorified his Servant Jesus?
questions.explanation: Peter said the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of their fathers, had glorified his Servant Jesus.

answers.text: The God of Moses and Aaron
The God of David and Solomon
The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob

questions.text: By what, according to Peter, had this man been made strong?
questions.explanation: Peter said that by faith in his name, his name had made this man strong, in the presence of them all.

answers.text: By the power of the apostles
By the prayers of the priests

questions.text: Who said that the Lord God would raise up a prophet like himself?
questions.explanation: Peter says that Moses said to the fathers that the Lord God would raise up a prophet for them from among their brothers, like him.
